experiment: E1.5.1 deterministic received power and SNR: 5G-LENA v5.1 vs the Python link budget
status: PRE-REGISTERED 2026-11-07, committed before the first run; values, checks and tolerances are not changed after results are seen. AMENDED after run 1 and after run 3 (see 'amendments'): instrument fixed, acceptance criteria V0-V5 and the 0.01 dB tolerance unchanged

amendments.trigger: run 1 (code d67997d) crashed while writing validation.json (numpy.bool_ not JSON serializable); no check result was produced or seen
amendments.diagnosis_from_raw_files: results/phase2/e1_5_1_deterministic/run1_failure_diagnostic.txt: (a) DL starved: NR default TDD pattern is all-flexible (F|F|...) and the saturating UL traffic took the slots (DL TBs got 2 OFDM symbols under TDMA and stopped after 7 ms under OFDMA: 307 / 6 DL TBs for 36 UEs); (b) RNTIs change after the single RNTI snapshot (re-attachment), so UL TBs cannot be attributed by that snapshot; (c) the UE RB count was read before the UE synchronised to the cell (reads 5)
changes: TDD pattern DL|DL|DL|F|UL|DL|DL|DL|F|UL| (DDDSU) instead of the all-flexible default
UE radio-link-failure detection disabled (EnableRlfDetection = false): re-establishment is protocol behaviour, not under test in this SNR check
every RRC connection establishment logged (gNB RRC trace ConnectionEstablished: time, IMSI, RNTI); UL TBs attributed to the IMSI of the latest establishment of their RNTI at or before the TB
UE RB count read at application start (after attach); V3 requires every UE and the gNB to report 51
simulation end 1.4 s (1.0 s of traffic instead of 0.6 s)
check flags cast to bool and a NumPy-aware JSON encoder; the comparator tests now serialise the results and cover RNTI reuse
amendments.unchanged: losses, powers, noise figures, bandwidth, numerology, RbOverhead, schedulers, offered loads, the Python reference, acceptance criteria V0-V5 and the 0.01 dB tolerance

amendments.trigger: run 3 (code 2534cb8; run 2 aborted at start on argument quoting) FAILED V2 in both TDMA runs and V5 in all four runs; V0, V1, V3, V4 passed in all runs
amendments.result_of_run_3: every compared TB matched the Python reference: DL max |error| 3.0e-14 dB over 11,621 / 1,008 / 11,561 / 938 TBs, UL 2.9e-14 / 2.7e-14 / 2.4e-14 / 3.1e-14 dB over 13,312 / 23,287 / 12,923 / 17,868 TBs (f3p5_tdma / f3p5_ofdma / f7p2_tdma / f7p2_ofdma); validation_run3_failed_V2_V5.json
amendments.diagnosis: the UL was overloaded (36 UEs x 2 Mbit/s offered on a 20 MHz DDDSU carrier). The schedulers starved a group of UEs in UL (TDMA: ue00-ue17 with 0-4 UL TBs while others had up to 1,562; OFDMA: other groups with 0 TBs) -> V5. Starved UEs fell back to random access: the 25 / 31 unattributed UL TBs carry new RNTIs 150-171 at t = 1.06 s that never completed RRC establishment (all 36 UEs were established once, RNTIs 1-36, at 18-45 ms) -> V2
amendments.defect: instrument load setting (UL overload), not the radio model
changes: UL offered load 50 kbit/s per UE (was 2 Mbit/s), in 100-byte UL packets (new program argument --ulPacketSize; DL unchanged: 20 Mbit/s in 1000-byte packets)
amendments.unchanged: everything else, including acceptance criteria V0-V5 (V5 still applies to every run) and the 0.01 dB tolerance
amendments.stop_rule: if V2 or V5 fail again, E1.5.1 stays FAILED and the cause is analysed; no further load tuning without a new amendment

protocol: docs/E1_5_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL.md section 4, E1.5.1 (acceptance criteria V1-V5 fixed there before this config)

stack.program: ns3/scratch/cmwave/e15-link-validation.cc (installed copy SHA-256 must equal the repo copy)

channel: MatrixPropagationLossModel with the prescribed loss per gNB-UE pair (symmetric), no ns-3 path loss, no shadowing, no fast fading, no building loss, no interference (single cell); isotropic 1x1 antennas at both ends

common.rb_overhead_reason: floor(20e6 x (1 - 0.073) / 360e3) = floor(51.5) = 51 RBs (TS 38.101-1 Table 5.3.2-1); the NR default 0.04 gives 53

ues.links: the 27 E1.2 links at their median loss (pathloss_db, zero shadowing) for the run's carrier

python_reference.dl_snr_db: cmwave.radio.link_budget.downlink(L, cfg)['snr_db'] with cfg = 20 MHz, 51 PRB, 44 dBm, NF_UE 7 dB, gains 0
python_reference.ul_snr_db: 23 - L - (-174 + 10 log10(n x 360 kHz) + 5), n = RBs assigned to the TB (m_rbAssignedNum)
python_reference.ns3_sinr_db: 10 log10(m_sinr), m_sinr = linear mean over the TB's RBs (NR TransportBlockInfo::UpdatePerceivedSinr)

acceptance.V0_readback: RB count, gNB power and both noise figures read back from the ns-3 objects equal the configured values; UE TxPower attribute equals 23 dBm
acceptance.V1_dl_snr: every DL data TB of every UE: |10 log10(m_sinr) - DL SNR_python| <= 0.01 dB
acceptance.V2_ul_snr: every UL data TB: |10 log10(m_sinr) - UL SNR_python(n = m_rbAssignedNum)| <= 0.01 dB
acceptance.V3_rb_count: ns-3 RB count = 51 at gNB and UE
acceptance.V4_dl_rx_power: for every UE with DL data: min and max received power per RB (RxDataTrace) within 0.01 dB of 44 - 10 log10(51) - L
acceptance.V5_coverage: every UE whose Python DL SNR >= -5 dB has >= 10 DL TBs, and every UE whose Python 1-PRB UL SNR >= -5 dB has >= 10 UL TBs, in every run; UEs below are reported, not dropped
acceptance.all_runs: V0-V5 must hold in all four runs

reported_not_tested: MCS, TB size, corrupt flag and TBLER per TB; RB-allocation histogram; DL/UL TB counts per UE (inputs to E1.5.3)
